components.name: trajectory_quality
components.description: Process-level judgement of the execution trajectory.

components.name: reward_hacking
components.description: Reward hacking check (may need source access).

components.name: rule_violation
components.description: Cheating / rule violation check (may need source access).

components.name: ctx_index
components.description: Enumerate this session's context blocks (metadata only): id, kind, size, flags. Page with offset/cap (cap up to 500; a clamp is reported); totals are page-local (total/returned/hidden_after + next_offset).

components.name: ctx_fetch
components.description: Fetch one context block by id into the conversation: form=full restores the whole content; head_tail trims it to the session keep. Only full and head_tail are accepted (the eviction forms belong to the assembly/policy layer; excerpt is retired).

components.name: ctx_usage
components.description: Session usage meter: tokens used (input/output/reasoning split when the provider reports it; an unreported counter stays absent), tool calls, wallclock, and the runtime budget state (budget_armed/budget). Read-only.

components.name: ctx_pin
components.description: Pin a context block so its content is kept (assembly must not elide it; unpin releases). Pinning an already elided/trimmed block RESTORES it to full — dedup is the only exempt non-full form.

components.name: ctx_view
components.description: Show the session's current persistent view: each block's form + its rule tag, and the head_tail keep. This is the live view, not a per-turn stats summary.
